experiments.name: Two source groups
experiments.interpretation: Two qualifying groups rate the agent 40 and 60.

experiments.name: 1,000 unlinked reviews without payments
experiments.interpretation: Failure: undetected new reviewer groups can inflate this payment-optional score.

experiments.name: 1,000 repetitions of one paid review
experiments.interpretation: Reusing the same reviewer and payment leaves group contributions unchanged.

experiments.name: 1,000 positive reviews in an existing group
experiments.interpretation: All added reviewers are assumed correctly linked to group b.

experiments.name: 1,000 reviews linked to the agent
experiments.interpretation: Correctly identified agent-linked groups are excluded.

experiments.name: 100 undetected paid reviewer groups
experiments.interpretation: Failure: payment evidence does not prevent inflation by undetected new groups; circular transfers do not affect this formula unless grouping captures the relationships.

experiments.name: One negative review in a source group
experiments.interpretation: Failure: an admitted zero rating lowers the whole group's contribution.

experiments.name: Ten favorable source groups
experiments.interpretation: An illustrative evidence-growth case; group independence is an assumption.

experiments.name: One hundred favorable source groups
experiments.interpretation: Additional favorable groups reduce the reserve's relative effect.
